effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.

sourceBasis.step: For each paired variable pair in the Cai–Juedes construction, two CNF clauses enforce exactly one true variable without adding variables. The CNF has O(h log r) variables for source weight h and r source variables. A computable exponent cutoff then bounds CNF-SAT time by a fixed power of r times a computable function of h, which would decide the W[1]-hard source problem in FPT time.

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides CNF-SAT within the stated running time.
